zh:
移除冗余的投掷物对齐计算，适配新版准星。
组件更名为 dtr-controller 和 dtr-hider，避免重名冲突。
请先更新 GUI，再通过 GUI 更新CSS组件；升级会自动清理旧版 DemoTracer 随包安装的对应插件，保留用户配置。
en:
Remove redundant projectile alignment calculations and support the updated crosshair format.
Rename the components to dtr-controller and dtr-hider to avoid naming conflicts.
Update the GUI first, then update the CSS components through the GUI. The upgrade automatically removes the corresponding plugins bundled with older DemoTracer versions while preserving user configuration.
